predecessors.name: Xianbei confederation
predecessors.text: the Murong home ground in the Daling river basin round their seats: Jinzhou (Jicheng) and Chaoyang, less the Yuwen disc round Chifeng; 'they resettled themselves around the Liaoxi region, where they…

successors.name: Former Yan
successors.text: the Murong land when Huang took the title Prince of Yan in November 337: the Daling basin round Jicheng and Chaoyang plus eastern Liaodong (annexed 319)

ledger.x: 235: the Murong break off from the Xianbei and settle in Liaoxi.
235: the Murong submit to Cao Wei.
February 266: Cao Wei ends and the Murong tie ends with it.
286: Buyeo is restored with Jin help.
294: Murong Hui founds a new capital.
333: Murong Ren holds Liaodong against Murong Huang.
23 November 337: Murong Huang takes the title Prince of Yan.
23 November 337: the Murong state becomes the Former Yan.

wars.name: Murong invasion of Buyeo
wars.outcome: The Murong under Hui overran Buyeo in 285, killing King Uiryeo and taking ten thousand prisoners; Buyeo was revived with Jin help, the page giving no year.

wars.name: Cui Bi's coalition against Murong Hui
wars.outcome: Cui Bi 'allied with the Duan, Yuwen, and Goguryeo to attack Murong Hui, but was defeated and forced to flee to Goguryeo'; Hui annexed eastern Liaodong.

wars.name: Murong-Yuwen wars of 320 and 325
wars.outcome: Murong Huang, on Hui's orders, fought the Yuwen in 320 and 325 ('fighting the powerful fellow Xianbei Yuwen tribe in 320 and 325'); the page records no change of ground.

wars.name: Murong Ren's revolt
wars.outcome: Murong Ren, Hui's son stationed at Pingguo, rebelled after Hui's death in 333, held Liaodong and in 334 styled himself Inspector of Pingzhou and Duke of Liaodong; he 'was defeated by Murong Huang's daring surprise attack through the frozen Bohai Sea in 336'…

certainty.note: A steppe-edge tribal chieftaincy: no page gives a boundary or an area; the Daling basin round Jicheng and Chaoyang stands for the tribal land, eastern Liaodong for the 319 annexation, and the 285 Buyeo core is a raid drawn as the buyeo…
